name: Bitcoin
description: The first cryptocurrency, created by an anonymous developer known as Satoshi Nakamoto. Often called digital gold.

name: Ethereum
description: A blockchain for smart contracts and decentralized apps. Switched from Proof of Work to Proof of Stake in 2022.

name: Solana
mechanism: Proof of Stake with Proof of History
description: A high-speed blockchain built for payments, decentralized finance, and other apps.

name: XRP
description: A digital asset designed for fast, low-cost international payments on the XRP Ledger.

name: Cardano
description: A blockchain developed through peer-reviewed research, designed for smart contracts and long-term sustainability.

name: Dogecoin
description: A cryptocurrency that began as a joke and became popular for online tipping and community use.

name: Litecoin
description: A cryptocurrency created as a faster, lighter alternative to Bitcoin.

name: Polkadot
description: A network that connects separate blockchains so they can share information and assets.

name: Avalanche
description: A blockchain platform known for fast transaction finality and support for custom networks.

name: Stellar
description: An open network for fast, low-cost payments and currency transfers between people and institutions.

name: Monero
description: A privacy-focused cryptocurrency that hides the sender, receiver, and amount of each transaction by default.

name: Algorand
description: A blockchain designed for fast, low-cost transactions and decentralized finance apps.

name: Tezos
description: A blockchain that can upgrade itself through community voting without splitting into separate chains.

name: Cosmos
description: A network of independent blockchains that can communicate with each other.

name: TRON
description: A blockchain focused on content sharing and decentralized apps.
